content.comment_body: Hello, I am using a mobile Android app to control my [product_name], and within my program, I want to apply an OR function to my analog input. My goal is to be able to set the value either through a slider or by assigning a fixed number to the analog amplifier. Is there a way to achieve this? Currently, I use an up/down counter connected to an analog multiplexer to select among four different preset values.

[user_name], I'm not entirely sure I understand your setup and requirement. However, please refer to the image attached. You are already familiar with the multiplexer component. Did you know it's possible to pass a variable reference to the multiplexer? This allows you to use values from building blocks like counters as well. If this doesn't clarify things, please provide more details about your question. If you speak German, you might also find the German language forum helpful. P.S. Controlling your setup with a mobile phone is a great idea. Best regards, [user_name]

Thank you, [user_name]. I added another multiplexer, using the counter multiplexer as one reference and another analog input as the other setpoint. I also introduced an input to select between S1=0 or S1=1, allowing me to choose between two different control methods for my analog values. The forum has been very helpful. For reference, the [product_name] is being used to control an air suspension system in a classic Oldsmobile car.

analysis.insight_summary: The user aims to combine multiple input sources—such as a slider from a mobile app and a fixed set value—to control an analog parameter in their [product_name] program, seeking logic that acts as an OR for analog signals. Their initial solution utilized a multiplexer with inputs managed by counters, but they were looking for a more flexible setup. Suggestions from the forum included using variable references and adding multiplexers for greater input adaptability, enabling the user to successfully achieve dual control options.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates configuring their [product_name] hardware so that analog input values can be adjusted either via a slider in a mobile app or by selecting a predefined value, with the ability to switch easily between these two sources. The solution should enable analog value control using either manual settings or remote input in their specific application.
